page.layout: One scan: a torn paper slip with handwritten accounts, pasted over a blank page; no printed text.
page.notes: The page carries only manuscript accounts in ink on a pasted slip: rows of sums and abbreviated names (such as "de Nobilibus pudore", "de Sparte", "glomeriis de Sartes", "patricius", "Claudius") with figures in pounds, shillings and pence, and a few struck-through totals. These are handwriting, not printed text, so they are left out of the transcription. The underlying page shows no print.
